context: A chef and barista plan an event
purpose: Teach: マリー/囲ん/のぼり/刻ん/年明け/回顧/実り/りょう

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、新春フェア、マリー風スイーツ、出そか。
lines.en: Aoi-san — should we put out those Marie-style sweets for the new year fair?
lines.style: Casual, upbeat Kansai cadence. Leans into the proposal like he's already picturing it. Warm and collaborative, not directive.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。店内、お花で囲んで、エレガントな雰囲気に。
lines.en: Yes. We'll surround the inside with flowers — really make it elegant.
lines.style: Soft but assured. Speaking a vision she's already thought through. Gentle pride in the detail work ahead.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 店先に、のぼり、立てて目立たせよか。
lines.en: What if we put up a banner out front to really catch people's eyes?
lines.style: Practical suggestion delivered with quiet confidence. Not pushy — offering an idea like someone who's seen what works.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メニューに、文字を刻んだ装飾、加えます。
lines.en: I'll add some decorative lettering to the menu boards too.
lines.style: Bright and decisive. She's already moving forward with the plans, building on his idea. Quick, energized.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 年明け早々、開店イベント、ええなあ。
lines.en: Starting the year off with an opening event like this — that's really nice.
lines.style: Warm appreciation, almost to himself. Slow on 'nice' — he means it. Satisfied with what they're building together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昨年を回顧して、改善点、メニューに反映します。
lines.en: I've been looking back at last year, and we're going to reflect those improvements right into the menu.
lines.style: Thoughtful and composed. She's speaking from reflection, not rushing. Steady, forward-thinking.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 実りある一年に、しよやな。
lines.en: Let's make this a really fruitful year for us.
lines.style: Genuine warmth, slight lift at the end. He's raising the moment a little — not just planning details, but building something together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 食材のりょう、月別に、調整します。
lines.en: I'm adjusting ingredient quantities month by month so we stay on top of everything.
lines.style: Warm, grounded close. Professional attention woven through genuine care. The kind of detail that shows she's in this with him.
